tours.name: DP World Tour Championship
tours.short_description: Dubai calls for the world's best golfers at this iconic, exhilarating golf tournament.
tours.about: Dubai calls for the world's best golfers at this iconic, exhilarating golf tournament. A standout event in the city's sporting calendar, the DP World Tour Championship, taking place from November 12 to 15, 2026, marks the end of the season and the conclusion to the Race to Dubai, with an elite field of golfers competing for the famous Harry Vardon Trophy at the beautiful Jumeirah Golf Estates.

tours.full_description:
Ticket options

West Grandstand

The West Grandstand offers prime viewing access to the circuit's longest straight, with cars surging past at incredible speeds before braking sharply for turns 6 and 7. The seat is perfect for fans looking to feel the pace of racing at full throttle, experiencing the epic power of the cars battling for victory. Between track sessions, you can step away from your seat and explore a world of F1 fandom across the circuit's Oasis areas and official F1 Fanzone

West Grandstand 4-day ticket

Access to the F1 Fanzone

1-day access to teamLab Phenomena Abu Dhabi or any one Yas Island Theme Park

Complimentary entry to Louvre Abu Dhabi and Qasr Al Watan

General admission to all after-race concerts at Etihad Park on a first-come, first-served basis

Price: AED 3,894 per person

West Club Grandstand

West Club Grandstand pairs high-speed racing with comfortable air-conditioned lounges to create a delightfully balanced fan experience. From here, you can feel every pulse of the battle on track while enjoying a la carte dining and paid bar in the lounge area. Tickets for the West Club also include unlimited access to the F1 Fanzone and Oasis areas, as well as the after-race concerts.

West Club Grandstand 4-day ticket

Exclusive access to air-conditioned lounge with à la carte dining and paid bar

Access to the F1 Fanzone

1-day access to teamLab Phenomena Abu Dhabi or any one Yas Island Theme Park

Complimentary entry to Louvre Abu Dhabi and Qasr Al Watan

General admission to all after-race concerts at Etihad Park on a first-come, first-served basis

Price: AED 4,804 per person

Main Grandstand

The Main Grandstand offers front-row access to the biggest moments of the Abu Dhabi race weekend. From lights out to the chequered flag, here you will have the best view of the starting grid, pit stop action, finish line drama and everything in between. Away from the track, you can enjoy access to the F1 Fanzone throughout the weekend.

Main Grandstand 4-day ticket

Access to the F1 Fanzone

1-day access to teamLab Phenomena Abu Dhabi or any one Yas Island Theme Park

Complimentary entry to Louvre Abu Dhabi and Qasr Al Watan

General admission to all after-race concerts at Etihad Park on a first-come, first-served basis

Price: AED 5,592 per person

North Yas Suite Premium

The North Yas Suite Premium is the home of excitement, luxury and comfort in equal measure. Overlooking turn 5, the suite offers balcony views over the circuit's tightest hairpin, so you can admire the technical abilities of the world's best drivers from a comfortable and convenient vantage point. There is also a premium bar serving drinks before, during and after the race, with dining options also available throughout the day.

North Yas Suite Premium 4-day ticket

Access to a plush indoor lounge with a balcony overlooking turn 5

Premium dining with soft drinks and a paid bar

Access to the F1 Fanzone

1-day access to teamLab Phenomena Abu Dhabi or any one Yas Island Theme Park

Complimentary entry to Louvre Abu Dhabi and Qasr Al Watan

General admission to all after-race concerts at Etihad Park on a first-come, first-served basis

Price: AED 6,872 per person

tours.name: Luxury Cruise
tours.short_description: Discover Dubai in style with the award-winning Xclusive Yachts.
tours.about: Discover Dubai in style with the award-winning Xclusive Yachts. Step onboard your own luxury yacht and take in the city’s iconic landmarks. Spot the towering Ain Wheel from the water, as well as the sail-shaped Burj Al Arab. Enjoy complimentary food and drinks along the way to make the most of the scenic backdrop. Morning, lunchtime, and sunset cruise slots are available – a perfect addition to your itinerary.
tours.full_description: Cruise from Dubai Marina past JBR, Ain Dubai and Burj Al Arab. The three-hour afternoon route also reaches Atlantis The Palm. Food and drinks depend on the sailing selected.

tours.name: Dubai Marina Dhow Cruise
tours.short_description: Set sail along the shimmering waters of the Dubai Marina Harbour.
tours.about: Set sail along the shimmering waters of the Dubai Marina Harbour. Indulge in a decadent 5-star dinner buffet aboard the luxurious dhow cruise tour. Relax in luxury as you explore serene waters and take in views of the harbour. Perfect photos are guaranteed aboard this traditional wooden boat. On your tour, you’ll also get to see Bluewaters Island, the Ain Wheel and the landmark Address Beach Resort.

tours.short_description: In Dubai, spending time on the water is a must.
tours.about:
In Dubai, spending time on the water is a must. Nothing quenches the heat like the sea breeze. So why not explore the city’s rich maritime heritage on an Abra boat tour? Experience miles of glorious coastline and witness iconic sights like Ain Dubai, Dubai Marina and Atlantis the Palm.

An Abra boat ride around Dubai is the perfect addition to your itinerary.
tours.full_description: Follow Dubai’s coast aboard an Abra with views of Atlantis, Ain Dubai, JBR and the Marina. Water, toilets and shower facilities are available aboard.
